item.title: Cao County Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning signal for heavy fog [Level III/Heavy]
item.description: Cao County Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog at 00:20 on October 21, 2026: It is expected that from early morning to morning this morning, all towns and streets under the jurisdiction of our county will have fog with visibility less than 500 meters, and local visibility less than 200 meters. Please take precautions!

item.title: Zichuan District Meteorological Observatory Upgrades and Issues Yellow Wind Warning Signal [Level III/Heavy]
item.description: At 00:13 on October 21, 2026, the Zichuan District Meteorological Observatory upgraded the blue warning signal for strong winds to a yellow warning signal for strong winds: Currently, there have been gusts of up to level 9 in Luocun Town, our district. It is expected that from early morning to daytime today, all towns and streets in our district will still experience northerly winds with an average wind speed of 5-6 levels and gusts of 7-9 levels. Please take precautions.
